head: 4491fcabddd0a68f9a2e59339bbdd9260eccca3b
notes: Logged in as the local-auth bootstrapped superadmin (admin@codemie.ai, is_admin=true, is_maintainer=true, IDP_PROVIDER=local). Verified: Create user button visible on /settings/administration/users; opens a modal with email/username/password/name fields and Auditor/Admin/Maintainer switches; role interdependency matches spec (enabling Admin clears+disables Auditor, enabling Maintainer forces Admin on and disables both Admin and Auditor, disabling Maintainer restores Admin to editable); submitting a valid unique user calls POST /v1/admin/users, closes the modal, shows the success toast ('User created successfully', rendered via toaster.info -> .codemie-toast-info), and refreshes the list to show the new user. Zero console errors and zero HTTP >=400 responses were observed once past the post-login landing page (see below).
